title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 61
description: Ten questions on Psalms 61: a cry from the end of the earth, the rock higher than I, God's tent and wings, and a prayer for the king.

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask God to listen to in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Psalms 61:1 says, "Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer."

questions.text: From where will the psalmist call to God?
questions.explanation: Psalms 61:2 says, "From the end of the earth, I will call to you."

answers.text: From the depths of the sea
From the end of the earth
From the top of a mountain

questions.text: When will the psalmist call to God, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Psalms 61:2 says he will call to God when his heart is overwhelmed.

questions.text: To which rock does the psalmist ask to be led?
questions.explanation: Psalms 61:2 says, "Lead me to the rock that is higher than I."

answers.text: The rock that is higher than I

questions.text: God has been a strong tower for the psalmist from what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 61:3 says God has been a refuge for him, a strong tower from the enemy.

questions.text: Where does the psalmist say he will dwell forever?
questions.explanation: Psalms 61:4 says, "I will dwell in your tent forever."

questions.text: In the shelter of what will the psalmist take refuge?
questions.explanation: Psalms 61:4 says, "I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings."

questions.text: Whose heritage has God given the psalmist?
questions.explanation: Psalms 61:5 says God has given him the heritage of those who fear his name.

questions.text: Whose life will God prolong, according to verse 6?
questions.explanation: Psalms 61:6 says, "You will prolong the king's life."

questions.text: Why will the psalmist sing praise to God's name forever?
questions.explanation: Psalms 61:8 says he will sing praise forever, that he may fulfill his vows daily.

answers.text: That he may fulfill his vows daily
